faqs.q: Why do garage door cables fail in Arlington Heights homes?
faqs.a: Garage door cables in Arlington Heights homes often fail due to age, wear, and local weather conditions. Properties from the 1950s in Pioneer Park to newer builds around Lake Arlington have garage doors that see daily use. Over time, cables can stretch, fray, or corrode. The significant temperature fluctuations from Chicago's hot summers to freezing winters also stress the metal, weakening the cables and making them prone to snapping or unwinding from their drums.

faqs.q: Will a cable repair affect my garage door opener's warranty?
faqs.a: A professional cable repair generally does not void your garage door opener's warranty. Cables are part of the door's counterbalance system, separate from the opener's motor and electronics. Our repairs focus on the door's mechanical components. We ensure correct tension and balance. This maintains the opener's proper function and extends its lifespan, rather than interfering with its warranty conditions.
